text:
maya: Hey team — Emberlane (tenant=emberlane-prod) completed onboarding but no API key shows in the console. Customer blocked on integration.

devlin: Can you paste the tenant/project id and any provisioner job id?

maya: tenant=emberlane-prod, project=emberlane-main, job=98765. UI just shows "No API keys" under Project keys. Provisioner reported success earlier but I see a rollback in the logs.

provisioner-bot: provision_job=98765 status=FAILED retries=2 error="claim-binding-timeout"

orion: digging into infra logs — seeing this repeatedly: `ERROR: project_claim_id not found for tenant emberlane-prod` in /var/log/provisioner/2026-03-16.log around job=98765.

maya: pasted snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] provisioner: start tenant=emberlane-prod job=98765
[2026-03-16T14:02:13Z] provisioner: create-service-account -> OK
[2026-03-16T14:02:14Z] provisioner: attach-claim -> ERROR: project_claim_id not found
[2026-03-16T14:02:14Z] provisioner: rolling back -> OK
```

devlin: Looks like an OIDC/claim propagation race — claim record not available when we try to bind, so provisioner rolls back leaving no key. Workaround for now: admin can manually bind and create a key. CLI command: `ri admin create-key --tenant emberlane-prod --project emberlane-main --label "onboard-temp"`.

jenna: I'll push a small change to the provisioner to retry attach-claim for up to 10s with exponential backoff and a metric when claim missing. Pushing a canary to staging now.

maya: Customer needs a temporary key asap. @devlin can you create one and set TTL 24h? I'll relay to Emberlane.

devlin: done — created key id=k_abc123 (expires in 24h). Sent secure note to Emberlane support. Also filed a follow-up to cleanup orphaned rollback state: TICKET-4521.

orion: INF ticket created INF-1523 to add claim-propagation latency metrics and a sticky retry loop for the binding controller. ETA ~48hrs to deployed fix.

maya: Great — I'll mark this as an escalation resolved once customer confirms the temp key works. Thanks all :thumbsup:
